name: Kaneshiro Keiji
source:
The protagonist—that is, you. Momoka's classmate. Cheerful and reasonably good-looking, he used to be fairly popular with girls. However, he was spotted by classmates while being doted on by an AV actress who came to his father's adult shop for a signing event. 

This led to the misunderstanding that he was a “womanizer.” Because of this, girls are overly wary of him, and he has never had a partner with whom he could have sex. He is still a virgin. Yet, out of a sad male pride, he cannot bring himself to clear up the misunderstanding that he is a “womanizer.”

He's lecherous and unprincipled, open to any kind of perverted play. He actively seeks out challenges like outdoor exhibitionism and groping games, often earning him the scornful label “shameless and thoughtless” from Momoka. Yet, he's also a devoted romantic at heart, wishing to spend his life with the one woman he's truly committed to.

[From [url=https://www.orcsoft.jp/dwf017/character.html]official site[/url]]
